facts.fact: Law 100/AN/20/8th L of 7 January 2021 creates the Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualite (ADN) as a public industrial and commercial body attached to the Ministry of Commerce, the national reference body for drawing up standards, in charge of preparing and approving standards and certifying conformity to them; the passages seen name no IT or data standard.
